title: Registration Now Open: REMAX R4 2027
summary: REMAX agents from around the world are invited to register for the global real estate brand’s flagship event taking place February 21–24, 2027 at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas.
body_markdown:
REMAX affiliates will be “All In, All Together” at the 2027 REMAX R4®. Drawing thousands of attendees from around the world, the annual convention promises networking opportunities, world-class training and masterminding sessions, and once-in-a-lifetime entertainment and speakers. No two events are ever the same!


This year’s R4 will take place on February 21-24, 2027 at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas.


Registration is now open and early bird registration is available on a first-come, first-served basis while inventory lasts.


[Register Now!](https://www.remaxevents.com/bdPYEr?RefId=RE%2FMAX+News+Summary+Link)


The annual convention invites more than 145,000 agents across more than 8,000 offices in over 120 countries and territories where REMAX has a presence to come together around a shared purpose and collective ambition. R4 2027 will build on longtime attendee favorites while introducing new experiences designed to inform, inspire and connect. R4 attendees can expect:


**Business Builders** – Morning Mastermind sessions and two full days of educational opportunities designed to sharpen strategies for the year ahead.


**Global Networking** – Opportunities to connect with agents from around the world, build referral relationships, expand professional networks and make lasting connections.


**The MarketPlace** – A hub for exploring tools, products, services and business solutions that support growth and productivity.


**Awards & Recognition** – A celebration of the global network’s top performers paired with a memorable dining experience.


**Fun Night** – The conference’s signature closing celebration for REMAX attendees and special guests.


The Opening General Session will feature Tamir Poleg, CEO of Real REMAX Group; Jenna Rozenblat, president; and Pritesh Dimani, chief technology officer, and kick off a program that includes a powerful lineup of keynote speakers, industry panel discussions and educational sessions to help agents navigate an evolving real estate landscape. Additional announcements to come.


Hotel reservations at the MGM Grand Hotel & Casino are also available starting today! Agents who reserve their rooms before January 25, 2027 can take advantage of discounted room rates.


**REMAX R4 | February 21 – 24, 2027 | MGM Grand Hotel & Casino | Las Vegas**


Written by **REMAX News**
